backpack_frame.notes: 背負子, the old backpack frame (1.05 m), upright; origin at its feet.

climb.note: Walk line on the great camphor (round 4b): from the foot of the ground limb G (north of the shrine, level with the ground) up G to the bowl on top of the trunk, east up P2, back west along P3 across the front of the trunk, round on P4 to the nest in the leader's fork. Points every 0.5 m on the top of the moss (object space of the tree; terrain.json climb.camphor has them in world space), width = what is walkable there. Slopes under 27 degrees: walk it like a slope, no climbing move.

camphor_great.notes: 御神木. Trunk 6.5 m across; buttress roots fitted to the ground of the saddle terrain at marker 'camphor' (0.0, 0.0), origin height 0.106 (do not rotate; rebuild after the terrain changes); low limbs reach 16.5 m. Shimenawa at 2.45 m.

chozubachi.notes: The water basin (手水鉢) before the shrine steps: a hollowed natural stone 1.2 m, a bamboo spout on a stand behind (the water falls into the bowl), three ladles on a bamboo rest, a flat stone in front.

dosojin.notes: Two stone figures, the right one under her wide hat (斗笠); a dish with two white dango on the ledge before them. Nodes Dango_0 / Dango_1 can be hidden or faded (meta w3a_far_mesh).

ema_kake.notes: A small roofed rack (1.3 m) with thirteen votive plaques (絵馬) on two rails.

endai.notes: A low bench (縁台) with a tray, two cups and a round fan.

fallen_branch.notes: A fallen branch, 2.8 m, a few dead leaves on it.

fence_rail.notes: Old post-and-rail fence, 2 m segment along x; segments join end to end.

fence_yotsume_a.notes: Bamboo lattice fence (四つ目垣), 2 m along x, with asagao vines; segments join end to end.

fence_yotsume_b.notes: Bamboo lattice fence (四つ目垣), 2 m along x, with gourd vines; segments join end to end.

fence_yotsume_c.notes: Bamboo lattice fence (四つ目垣), 2 m along x, with few vines; segments join end to end.

furusugi_a.notes: An old cedar broken at 7.2 m long ago, two upturned leaders to 9.6 m; trunk 1.2-1.5 m across at the foot. The gates' trees (the michikiri rope is tied round it at 4.6 m).

gate_stones.notes: The east gate of the barrier: two old standing stones (1.7 and 1.45 m) 3.3 m apart, the path passes between; the michikiri rope (michikiri_e) hangs over them between two old cedars.

graves.notes: The nine nameless graves (無縁墓) in a row 9.2 m long on their bench, origin at the graves marker. anchors.hook_0..9: where the ten paper lanterns (lights/lantern_paper, anchors.hang) hang.

hatake.notes: The vegetable garden (畑), 6.2 x 3.6 m: four ridges along x (from the back: cucumbers on a bamboo frame, eggplants, ground cherries with green onions, young greens), stones along the front edge.

hiraishi.notes: A flat stone by the graves, 0.75 x 0.5 m, top at 0.18 m: where she lays her towel.

houki.notes: A bamboo broom leaning back against a wall behind it (-z).

hut.notes: The home (母屋), round 4: main house walls 7.6 x 4.4 m, thatch 9.8 x 6.6 m in three courses with a 0.6 m cut eave, ridge 6.8 m with a turf ridge (grass, iris, lilies), engawa along three bays, shoji (material minka_shoji: lit from inside after dusk), the doma door with a noren (east bay), a board-roofed lean-to on the west with the kitchen chimney. Node Door: the doma sliding door. anchors: door (where she stands to go in), smoke (chimney top), light (the brazier inside), cat (on the engawa), light_door (a lantern hook by the doma).

itabashi.notes: A plank bridge 3.6 x 1.25 m over a small stream (long axis z); place with hang ~0.7 so the deck (0.17 m over the origin) sits on the banks.

iwakura.notes: A great rock held sacred (磐座), 2.7 x 1.9 m, mossy on top, a rope round its girth with four streamers.

jizo.notes: A roadside Jizo (0.7 m) with a red bib and cap on a little stone base, a flower in a bamboo cup.

kakashi.notes: A scarecrow (案山子) in an old patched kimono and a sedge hat.

kakehi.notes: Bamboo water spout (筧) carrying the spring into a stone basin; the pipe starts 2.4 m behind (-z) at the spring.

kakehi_yard.notes: Split-bamboo pipes from the hill (3.4 m toward -x) into a stone trough; a tub of spring water beside it with a watermelon, cucumbers and tomatoes cooling. Rotate so the pipe points uphill.

kaki_a.notes: 柿 with fruit (ripe orange and a few still gold); anchors.fruit lists them.

kaki_b.notes: 柿 with fruit (ripe orange and a few still gold); anchors.fruit lists them.

kaki_c.notes: 柿 with fruit (ripe orange and a few still gold); anchors.fruit lists them.

kare_a.notes: 枯れ木: a dead konara she may cut (the stump with the axe stands by it).

kare_b.notes: 枯れ木: a dead konara she may cut (the stump with the axe stands by it).

lantern_paper.notes: White chochin, 0.58 m with its loop; origin at the bottom rim, anchors.hang at the loop top. Ten of these hang on the graves' hooks (graves anchors.hook_*).

makiwari.notes: The chopping block (薪割り台): a stump 45 cm across with axe cuts, a split log on it, split pieces and wood chips around (thickest toward +z).

maple_a.notes: イロハモミジ, summer green

maple_b.notes: イロハモミジ, summer green

maple_c.notes: イロハモミジ, summer green

massha.notes: A little side shrine (末社, 0.95 m) on a stone, its rope and two streamers, a sake cup and a flask.

michikiri_e.notes: The east gate's michikiri (道切り): a thick straw rope 8.4 m long tied round two old cedars at x = -4.2 and 4.2 (4.6 m up; the trees stand on the same level ground as the rope's origin), across the way, sagging to 4.1 m; straw tassels along it; a giant straw sandal (大わらじ, 1.9 m) hangs from the middle by its toe: node "Waraji", turned slowly by the dressing (dressing.gd).

michikiri_n.notes: A thinner michikiri rope for the north and south-west gates: 4.6 m between two trees at x = -2.3 and 2.3 (3.7 m up), three straw tassels, no sandal.

mizugame.notes: A big glazed water jar (水甕) with a board lid and a ladle.

monohoshi.notes: Laundry pole on two forked posts (3.6 m), an indigo kimono through its sleeves, two tenugui, a red cloth; the cloth swings with the wind (foliage material, mesh mode).

mushiro.notes: A straw mat (筵) 1.8 x 0.9 m lying flat, its +x end rolled; red peppers drying on the -x half, a heap of beans on the +x half. Walkable over (no footprint).

neko.notes: A calico cat (三毛猫) asleep, curled up, 0.5 m long; place on the engawa.

niwatori_a.notes: A hen, about 0.36 m tall, facing +x, head up.

niwatori_b.notes: A hen, about 0.36 m tall, facing +x and pecking at the ground.

nougu.notes: Farm tools leaning on a fence: a hoe, a winnowing basket, a sickle on the rail (place against a fence, the fence 0.1 m behind).

offering_box.notes: Offering box before the shrine; anchors.glint: coins inside that catch the light.

radio.notes: A wooden radio (case 0.36 x 0.25 x 0.14 m) hung on a nail: origin = the nail; the case hangs 0.06-0.31 m below it, its back against the post (+z is its front).

sekimori.notes: A boundary stone (関守石): a round stone tied with a black cross of rope, set on a path: go no further.

shiorido.notes: The yard's brushwood gate (枝折戸), 1 m wide, the leaf swung open; between two posts (x +-0.56).

shoikago.notes: A bamboo back basket 0.72 m tall leaning back 10 degrees (against the camphor's root, under the shimenawa: it keeps its colour the next morning, being under the rope).

shrine.notes: Small gabled shrine on a stone base; the porch eave beam is the node EaveBeam (scene shrine). shrine_fallen: the beam lies across the porch step (node EaveBeam moved), a post leans, the eave sags. The beam alone: objects/shrine_beam.

shrine_beam.notes: The shrine porch eave beam alone (1.8 m), centred; for the fallen state place it at shrine anchors.beam_fallen (yaw 0.5 rad, roll 0.25 rad).

signpost_a.notes: Wooden signpost with two blank arms (no text).

stone_lantern.notes: Kasuga-style stone lantern (simplified), 1.52 m; a pair flanks the shrine steps. Variants: lit (the fire box glows at dusk and night), far (faded).

stone_lantern_old.notes: Old weathered stone lantern, squat, leaning a little, mossy. Variants: lit (the fire box glows at dusk and night), far (faded).

stump_axe.notes: A cut stump with an axe bitten into it, chips around (by the tree she may cut).

susuki_a.notes: 薄 clump with silvery plumes (card sprites).

susuki_b.notes: 薄 clump with silvery plumes (card sprites).

susuki_c.notes: 薄 clump with silvery plumes (card sprites).

susuki_d.notes: 薄 clump with silvery plumes (card sprites).

teoke.notes: A small wooden bucket with water in it.

tsubaki_a.notes: 椿: dark glossy leaves, a few red flowers.

tsubaki_b.notes: 椿: dark glossy leaves, a few red flowers.

wara_heap.notes: Straw bundles lying in a heap.

wara_kuzu.notes: Loose straw bits on the ground, a patch about 1.6 x 1.0 m (no footprint).

waymark_a.notes: Stone waymark (道しるべ), blank, leaning.

woodpile.notes: Stacked split firewood (薪) between stakes under a board, 1.7 m long; split ends face front and back.

zaru.notes: Flat basket (笊) with a few greens.
